text: I think you'll enjoy this Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto recipe, given your affinity for international flavors and beef-based dishes. While risotto typically features Italian ingredients, this recipe's use of cream of mushroom soup and chicken stock gives it a slightly different twist. The addition of mushrooms and parmesan cheese will likely appeal to your taste buds, and the cooking time of about 40 minutes is relatively quick compared to some of your other liked recipes.
